question: In a code language, ‘LAND’ is written as ‘IWKZ’, and ‘GOLD’ is written as ‘DKIZ’. How will ‘TEAM’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30dbf680205b2ac5ef3c42da1ffec8619642030da36e21c43297a3224c70e079.png] 

**LAND: IWKZ**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/48cabfc8989bdebc82cc15929e81e01cbf2855e6afb1f052ce2eef9d2b58dbd7.png] 

**GOLD: DKIZ**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/18d11e9d76e01f995ae6bab0bbf2ea9d9d6cbe574ef7c676315db8fd4a93fc57.png] 

Similarly,

**TEAM: ?**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fe4668e0e3ffc1e5ab30031c774f9718c1d20f31873146be0f6de22952651d51.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"QAXI"**.
